femeninas.description: Voz femenina natural en ingles americano; presentacion/demo de producto moderno.

variants.label: Presentacion elegante
variants.instructions: Use a natural adult feminine voice in neutral American English. Deliver a polished, contemporary product keynote: composed, confident, clear, and quietly enthusiastic. Use a smooth mid-range pitch and measured pacing, with subtle emphasis on the product name and engineers. Read only the supplied sentence. Pronounce Digi as dih-jee. Take a short natural pause after Digi Field App. Keep the recording as clean spoken narration.

variants.label: Lanzamiento moderno
variants.instructions: Use a natural adult feminine voice in neutral American English. Present a new app with bright confidence, a slight audible smile, and modern product-launch energy. Keep the pitch naturally feminine, the diction crisp, and the delivery polished and engaging. Read only the supplied sentence. Pronounce Digi as dih-jee. Give a brief natural pause after Digi Field App and gently emphasize modern and engineers. Clean studio narration.

variants.label: Demo tecnologica

Pause briefly after Digi Field App, with subtle emphasis on app and engineers. Clean spoken narration.
